name: Jeff Hodge
prior_offices: Crook County sheriff (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Jeff Hodge is the Crook County sheriff and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official elected officials page lists him in that office, and the official general election summary lists him as the winner of the sheriff race.
